name: Idols
tagline: Every colour at once, and somehow it works.

facts.note: A twenty-creator mega-collaboration hosted by Herdys and Zafkiel, blending 1.9, 2.0 and 2.1 design styles in one level. The level's own in-game description settles a conflict between sources: Dorami verified it and Dosh7t bugfixed it, which is why Pointercrate credits Dosh7t. The track is Sparkler's remix of Virtual Riot's 'Idols'; the original upload, Newgrounds 595989, has been deleted.

spotlight.sub: 1.9, 2.0 and 2.1 styles in one level, and it still reads as a single continuous piece.

voice.hook: Pure, unadulterated joy in megacollab form.
voice.why:
Idols is pure, unadulterated joy in the form of a Geometry Dash megacollab. Hosted by Zafkiel, it uses Virtual Riot's “Idols” to create one of the most perfectly synced, vibrant and energetic levels in the game's history.

Unlike the standard hell-themed extremes, this level is a massive explosion of colour, utilising 1.9, 2.0 and 2.1 design styles that somehow blend together into a cohesive, beautifully paced journey. The way the decoration pulses and shifts exactly with the EDM drops makes it incredibly satisfying to watch, and even more satisfying to play.
